annotations.title: Monitor Google News Full Text, RAG Chunks & B2B Triggers

description:
Scrape Google News across EN/KO/JA/DE/ES with 5-in-1 publisher URL decoding (Bing News fallback), streaming HTML full-text & 512-token RAG chunks, 3-layer paywall sibling rescue, 10 B2B/PR event triggers, cross-lingual clustering, and $0-skip watchDiff monitoring.

Parameters: Supply queries, topics, or topicOrClusterUrls (defaults to NVIDIA AI). Mode params: news_headlines_intel uses decodeUrls/onlyWithTriggers; full_article_rag adds streaming full text, paywall rescue, onlyFullText, and ragChunkMaxTokens. Supports locales, timeframe, dedupeSimilarStories, watchDiff + dedupStoreName, and webhookUrl. Requires APIFY_TOKEN.

Billing: 128 MB pure HTTP ($0 proxy); $0.80/1K headlines or $1.50/1K full-text RAG articles (up to 50% off; $0 on watchDiff skips/filtered misses). Use for live news RAG, PR crisis & B2B trigger tracking; do not use for Substack newsletters (audit_substack_newsletters_leads).

decodeUrls.description: Decode obfuscated news.google.com redirect links into real publisher URLs in 5-in-1 pure HTTP batches.

dedupStoreName.description: Named Apify Key-Value Store for watchDiff 90-day rolling LRU snapshots.

dedupeSimilarStories.description: Emit 1 canonical representative per cross-lingual story cluster with coverageCount and relatedSources.

locales.description: COUNTRY:lang locales for cross-lingual monitoring and clustering (e.g. ["US:en", "KR:ko", "JP:ja", "DE:de", "ES:es"]).

maxArticles.description: Maximum deduplicated stories to process per run (1-2,000).

mode.description: news_headlines_intel ($0.80/1K: decoded URLs + 10 B2B/PR triggers + clusters) or full_article_rag ($1.50/1K: adds streaming full text, 3-layer paywall sibling rescue & 512-token RAG chunks).

onlyFullText.description: In full_article_rag mode, skip blocked/paywalled rows without full text or sibling rescue at $0.

onlyWithTriggers.description: Pre-charge filter: emit only stories matching at least one of the 10 B2B/PR event triggers ($0 otherwise).

queries.description: Search keywords or boolean queries (e.g. ["OpenAI", "NVIDIA AI", "cyberattack healthcare"]).

ragChunkMaxTokens.description: In full_article_rag mode, target token size for overlap-preserving ragChunks (128-2,048).

timeframe.description: Recency window applied to search queries (e.g. "24h" for daily cron, "7d" for weekly briefs).

topicOrClusterUrls.description: Optional direct Google News topic, search, or RSS feed URLs.

watchDiff.description: Skip previously seen articles BEFORE URL decoding at $0 using immutable run-delta KV snapshots.

webhookUrl.description: Optional SSRF-protected HTTPS webhook URL to receive run summary and breaking triggers.

name: monitor_google_news_rag_triggers

actor.description: Apify Actor slug that produced these records.

count.description: Total number of records returned in items.

items.description: Decoded Google News intelligence records with B2B/PR triggers, cross-lingual clusters, and optional full-text RAG chunks.

cleanPlainText.description: Clean full-text article body for AI/RAG pipelines (full_article_rag mode).

coverageCount.description: Number of publishers covering this story cluster.

crisisAlert.description: True when active crisis trigger is not negated.

eventTriggers.description: Detected B2B/PR event triggers (FUNDING, MA, LAYOFF, BREACH, RECALL, etc.).

extractionStatus.description: RSS_ONLY, FULL, RESCUED_FROM_SIBLING, PAYWALL_TRUNCATED, or BLOCKED.

publisherUrl.description: Decoded canonical publisher URL (or null if decodeUrls is false).

rescuedFromPublisher.description: Free cluster-sibling publisher name when Layer-3 paywall rescue succeeded.

wordCount.description: Effective word count (CJK-normalized) in full_article_rag mode.
